text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Trainer, I did it.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I think I was able to show
everyone
what I'm really made of.

text_block_list.name: Crowd
text_block_list.text: Woooo!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Wait. I can hear cheers from outside.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text: Oguri was amazing!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
I know it isn't her best distance, but I
really want
to see her in the year-end
race!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
...It sounds like everyone has high
expectations
for me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
I wanna do it... I wanna run in the Arima
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Oguri Cap is really motivated. This
seems like the
perfect opportunity to
share my good news with
her.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
So you think I'll get to run in the Arima
Kinen?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I look at online polls and
newspaper
predictions, Oguri Cap's
name is always there.
choice_data_list: If we keep this up, you'll definitely qualify!

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Really? Everyone must have such high
hopes for
me.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Their support is my strength. There's no
way I can
lose like this!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The spectators' enthusiasm, Oguri Cap's
passion,
and my own fervor have all
reached a fever pitch.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... And I'm gonna make it! It's the
race of my
dreams!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: On the way home...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Pant... pant... All right, one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
W-wait a minute, Creek! Isn't it 'bout
time you
took a break?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
It's nice to see ya so passionate, but
you're going
too far! This isn't like you!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh dear, are you worried about me?
You're such
a sweetheart! ♪

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Hey, don't deflect! This is 'cause of
summer camp,
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
Ever since you raced against Oguri,
you've been
pushing yourself way too
hard!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: ...I couldn't get ahead of her.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
If we were to race again right now, I
know I'd lose.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I want to excel in more than just the
races I'm
already good at—and to do
that, I need to build
stamina.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
But Creek... Why are you so hung up on
Oguri?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I can't lose to her. If I'm not strong
myself, how
am I supposed to support
anyone else?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I want to be the strongest and most
reliable
person around.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
That's why I need to get even stronger.
I've got to
be miles ahead of Oguri!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
...All right, all right. I get it! No need to
get so
worked up!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text:
I'll leave ya to it. But remember to stay
hydrated.
I'm gonna fetch you some
water!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
...Thanks, Inari. You really are a
sweetheart.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Creek.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Hello there, Oguri.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
You had a race today, didn't you? I'm
sure you
did great, as always.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Thank you...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Super Creek's name has been in every
single
Arima Kinen poll I've come across.
It looks like
these two will finally be
going head-to-head in a
real race!

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I can't wait for the Arima Kinen. If you're
able to
run against me again, that'll be
the icing on the
cake.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I might not have beaten you at
summer
camp, but things will be
different this time.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Is that so? Let's both do our best, then.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
And one more thing... I have no intention
of
losing either. Please bear that in mind.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
Of course. I want you to be in top form
when I
beat you.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Great! ♪ I'd better carry on with my
training,
then.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: ...Creek is working really hard.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text:
There may not be long left until the
Arima Kinen,
but I want to do everything
I can to prepare too.

text_block_list.name: Oguri Cap
text_block_list.text: Trainer, please lend me your support!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The big race is just days away. I once
again
resolve to make sure that Oguri
Cap comes out
on top.
